projects.name: TxDOT DCIS All Projects
projects.notes: All TxDOT projects, past and future (66 distinct PROJ_CLASS values; 25 listed). PROJ_STG is the phase; PROJ_STAT is Active/Closed/Inactive/Paused (22,161 not Closed). Planned work = PROJ_STG in Planning/Initiate/PE/PS&E/Ready to Let/Letting etc. with PROJ_STAT='Active' (11,755 records are neither Closed nor Construction). ACTUAL_LET_DATE is filled once let. PRJ_UTP=1 flags Unified Transportation Program projects. The older TxDOT_Projects service on the same host now answers 'Token Required'.

parcels_statewide.name: TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels (most recent)
parcels_statewide.notes: IMPORTANT LIMIT: the layer's /query operation answers 'Requested operation is not supported by this service' (count and where-queries both fail). What does work, and was verified with real data, is the map service's identify operation: .../MapServer/identify?geometry=<lon,lat>&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&sr=4326&layers=all&tolerance=2&mapExtent=<bbox>&imageDisplay=800,800,96&returnGeometry=false&f=json returned a Travis County parcel with OWNER_NAME, MAIL_ADDR, SITUS_ADDR, MKT_VALUE (identify returns the field names in upper case). So owners can be looked up point by point along a project line, but not bulk-downloaded through this service. Other fields: geo_id, name_care, land_value, imp_value, legal_desc, fips, tax_year, source (appraisal district). Coverage and currency vary by county. Copyright text: 'TxGIO, Various Counties, Various Vendors'; no use restriction stated in the service. RE-CHECKED 2026-11-17: /query still rejects every request (count, where, objectIds, spatial point, GET and POST) with 'Requested operation is not supported by this service', although the service lists capabilities 'Query,Map'; /find is rejected too; there is no FeatureServer. So it is marked verified=false under the rule that a layer must answer spatial queries. The identify operation does work as a point lookup (use layers=all:0, tolerance in pixels, and a mapExtent/imageDisplay that give a map scale between 1:1,000 and 1:500,000; a 0.02-degree extent at 800x800 with tolerance=20 reaches roughly 55 m). Johnson County is the one target county where this is the only owner source found; its sample had OWNER_NAME filled and MAIL_ADDR 'Null'. Terms read: the TxGIO DataHub catalog (https://api.tnris.org/api/v1/collections?search=parcels) lists every 'Land Parcels' collection, including the one acquired 2026-09-25, under 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal' (https://spdx.org/licenses/CC0-1.0.html); no limit on commercial use or solicitation is stated. The same data can be downloaded per county as shapefiles from data.geographic.texas.gov (not tested here). No TxGIO-owned copy was found on arcgis.com; copies there are uploads by unrelated users.
parcels_statewide.coverage: Statewide service (not split by county). Point lookups via identify returned 2026 tax-year parcels with owner names in all 16 counties tested on 2026-11-17: Hidalgo, Denton, Johnson, Williamson, Collin, Galveston, Brazoria, Hays, El Paso, Ellis, Fort Bend, Montgomery, Harris, Dallas, Tarrant, Bexar (plus Travis). Full county list could not be counted because /query is disabled.

parcels_counties.name: RGV911 Basemap - Hidalgo Parcels (Hidalgo CAD attributes)
parcels_counties.notes: Published by the Rio Grande Valley 911 district, not by Hidalgo CAD; rows carry Hidalgo CAD editor codes and were loaded 2026-08. Owner name filled on 331,009 of 334,098. MAILING ADDRESS IS PARTIAL: only addr_line1 (street line) is filled; addr_city, addr_state, zip and market are null on every record, so city/state/ZIP must come from the statewide identify lookup (MAIL_ADDR). Hidalgo CAD's own server (propaccess.hidalgoad.org) no longer resolves. 200 m spatial query at McAllen returned 81 parcels.

parcels_counties.name: Denton County GIS Parcels_FC (Denton CAD data)
parcels_counties.notes: Denton County's own ArcGIS server; item summary says "DCAD's Update Parcel data - 01/05/2026", sample pYear 2027. nameSecondary holds care-of lines; 'confidential' flag field present. 200 m spatial query at Denton returned 82 parcels.

parcels_counties.name: JohnsonCADWebService - Parcels
parcels_counties.notes: NOT USABLE FOR OWNERS: the layer answers spatial queries (geometry and prop_id/geo_id only) but file_as_name is null on all 100,415 records and the address and value fields are blank, so it is marked verified=false. Johnson CAD's other services need a token (jcadgis.johnsoncad.com ParcelsPublic: 'Token Required'). Owner names for Johnson come only from the statewide identify lookup, or for the Fort Worth fringe from the Tarrant layer already on file.

parcels_counties.name: WCAD Tax Parcels
parcels_counties.notes: Published by Williamson Central Appraisal District (gisadmin_WCAD), 'Updated Nightly'. OWNERNME2 for a second owner; PropertyID is the numeric id. CNTASSDVAL (current value) was 0 in samples while PRVASSDVAL (prior) was filled. Terms read at https://www.wcad.org/data-downloads/ : only an 'As Is' no-warranty disclaimer, no limit on commercial use or solicitation. Williamson County also publishes a slimmer copy with owner (FullName) but no mailing address: https://services.arcgis.com/5ZjkDcAQQjFnTEkh/arcgis/rest/services/wcad_parcels_view/FeatureServer/0 . DISTANCE CAVEAT: the layer is stored in State Plane feet and a point query with distance=200&units=esriSRUnit_Meter reaches about 3.28 times too far (returned several hundred parcels; a 400 m bounding box returns about 100). Use geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope, or divide the distance by 3.28.

summary: Projects: TxDOT DCIS All Projects works well (73k lines with phase, cost and let dates). Parcels: the statewide TxGIO layer has owner and mailing address (CC0) for every county tested but still rejects /query; only point 'identify' lookups work. Queryable owner layers verified for Harris, Dallas, Tarrant, Bexar, Travis, and (added 2026-11-17) Hidalgo, Denton, Williamson, Collin, Galveston, Brazoria, Hays, El Paso, Ellis, Fort Bend and Montgomery. Johnson has no queryable owner layer (its CAD layer has blank owner fields).
